SELECT * from BUSC.TRY_SDI


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT ID,Beneficiary_id, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI GROUP BY ID,Beneficiary_id HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ID,Beneficiary_id ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.TRY_SDI_WITH_DUP_20230509  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI
--30932
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI_WITH_DUP_20230509
--30932

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.TRY_SDI; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.TRY_SDI_WITH_DUP_20230509 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.TRY_SDI --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[Beneficiary]
,[Beneficiary_Id]
,[CBCGLAcctEncryted]
,[CBCGLAcctSixDigits]
,[Currencies]
,[Direct]
,[Id]
,[Method]
,[Pay_Receive]
,[ProcessingOrg]
,[Products]
,[Roles]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI_WITH_DUP_20230509; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT ID,Beneficiary_Id, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI WHERE ISLATEST = 1 GROUP BY ID,Beneficiary_Id HAVING COUNT(1)>1;

--7

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI
--30932
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI_WITH_DUP_20230509
--30932
